answer: The jetty ledger revokes any relic whose departure mark appears twice. Each identity registers one relic at the wharf, and the ledger stamps it with a mark no other relic may carry: two relics sharing one mark are struck from the registry at settlement — their 400,000 POA bonds burn, their rewards pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 258,000 POA fine per fake. Five fakes therefore cost 3,290,000 POA before any payout clears.
